slides.heading: What it is
paras: Stand up Onyx (formerly Danswer, github.com/onyx-dot-app/onyx) as a self-hosted knowledge layer over everything that is not code: project notes, MEMORY.md files, guides, GitHub repos, optionally Gmail and Drive.

slides.heading: What a pro would do that you didn't ask for
paras: Build the evaluation before tuning anything: a golden set of 30 real questions whose answers live in known documents, scored on citation correctness, so every change to chunking, embeddings, or reranker has a number.

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: eval_onyx.py on the 10 held-out golden questions: citation hit at 80% or better, with 10 rows hand-checked by opening the cited file.
docker stats peak table across first full index on this machine: total under available RAM with zero container restarts (docker ps restart count).

slides.heading: Vespa or the model server is OOM-killed during first…
paras: container restarts, indexing stalls at a fixed count.
lower INDEX_BATCH_SIZE, switch to Lite, or add swap; re-measure.
